info.name: Google Cloud Translation Detections Languages API
Google Cloud Translation API List Supported Languages

params.name: target
params.description: The language to use to return localized, human readable names of supported languages.

params.name: model
params.description: The translation model. Can be either base for the Phrase-Based Machine Translation model, or nmt for the Neural Machine Translation model.

items.docs: Returns a list of supported languages for translation.
